_meta.what: THE queue - every task, idea, and open decision in one file. The Todo tab renders only type:task rows, but writes preserve every row, so ideas and decisions can never be dropped by a save. Replace these examples with your own.

items.text: Example starred task - this is what Today's Focus shows on the Home tab
Example task - unstarred, so it only shows under All or its project tab
Example starred task on a second project - replace with your own
Example task with no project - anything typed into the General add row lands here
Example finished task - marked done, so it shows on the Archive tab
Example idea - kept in the same file but never rendered on the Todo tab
Example open decision - replace with a real one you keep deferring
